div.div:
HS flags (6): active = rxactivehs_x, valid = rxvalidhs_x, sync = rxsynchs_x, SoT error = errsoths_x, SoT sync error = errsotsynchs_x, deskew = rxskewcalhs_x.
LP flags (9): stopstate_x, rxulpsesc_x, erresc_x, errcontrol_x, ulpsactivenot_x, rxtriggeresc_x [3:0].
Over SPI: configuration, enables, init_done, clock-lane flags. Not pinned: rxclkesc_x, LPDT outputs (tied 0).
